correctness.rationale: Direct substitution of z_n=eta_n w_n into the printed model produces an unavoidable eta_{n+1}/eta_n factor. The source's ratio-free equation therefore holds on positive states exactly for constant eta. The threshold product remains unchanged because the phase ratios telescope over one period. The rational two-season witness satisfies the source's biological parameter bounds, has alpha=36/25, and gives an exact one-step contradiction to the claimed rescaling. The return-map fixed-point polynomial and uniqueness of its positive root are independently reconstructed in the bundled checker.

value.rationale: The paper explicitly introduces eta(n) as a seasonal environmental parameter, then fixes eta(n) identically equal to one in simulations on the stated premise that arbitrary eta(n) can be scaled out. The correction shows exactly why that premise fails, while preserving the valid threshold result. This is not merely a notation issue: the exact two-season witness produces a factor-three normalized discrepancy in one step and a different positive two-cycle. The result therefore determines which simulation conclusions are transferable across density-dependence profiles and which require new computation.
